Are you tired of looking up reference ranges every time you need to interpret a paediatric EKG? Every age and rate has specific normal ranges that are impossible to remember. Often more subtle conditions will get missed because a full review of the EKG and comparison to normal ranges takes so much time.

This app was created by a pediatric doctor. It has internationally accepted reference ranges built into the app. Simply put in the date of birth and use the unit of "small squares" to put in the details of your EKG - it will tell you the calculated result as well as the relevant reference range and if it's normal or not. No more manual calculations. No more time looking up reference tables.

It turns a 15min job into 30 seconds. 

Useful for anyone looking at EKGs including MD's, residents, family physicians, emergency doctors, pediatricians and neonatologists.
